name: DS248x 1-Wire Bus Master
description: The `ds248x` component supports DS2482-100, DS2482-101, DS2482-800, and DS2484 I2C-to-1-Wire bridge chips. Configure the bridge itself under `ds248x`, then create one or more [1-Wire bus](https://esphome.io/components/one_wire/) entries using the `ds248x` platform.

config_entries.label: Address
config_entries.description: The I²C address of the device. Defaults to `0x18`.

config_entries.label: I2C ID
config_entries.description: The ID of the [I²C bus](https://esphome.io/components/i2c/) to use. Required if you have configured multiple I²C buses.

config_entries.label: Sleep Pin
config_entries.description: A GPIO pin connected to the `SLPZ` pin. Only available for `ds2482-101` and `ds2484`.

config_entries.label: Mode
config_entries.description: Pin mode flags (input / output / pullup / pulldown / open_drain). Combine flags as needed — e.g. input + pullup for a button pulled to VCC.

config_entries.label: Open Drain
config_entries.description: Set the open drain mode flag.

config_entries.label: Inverted
config_entries.description: Invert the logical level. ``true`` swaps high/low in software so an active-low button reads as active when grounded.

config_entries.label: ID
config_entries.description: Manually specify the ID of the 1-Wire bus. Required if you have configured multiple 1-Wire buses.

config_entries.label: Active Pullup
config_entries.description: Enable the active pullup feature. Useful for long lines or heavier bus loads. Defaults to `false`.

config_entries.label: Active Pullup Resistance
config_entries.description: The active pullup resistance. One of `500ohm` or `1000ohm`.

config_entries.label: Bus Sleep
config_entries.description: Put the 1-Wire bus to sleep when not in use. Only available for `ds2482-101` and `ds2484`. Defaults to `false`.

config_entries.label: Hub Sleep
config_entries.description: Put the bridge chip to sleep when not in use. Requires `sleep_pin` and is only available for `ds2482-101` and `ds2484`. Defaults to `false`.

config_entries.label: Master Sample Time
config_entries.description: Adjust the master sample time (`tMSP`). Value from `0` to `15`.

config_entries.label: Recovery Time
config_entries.description: Adjust the recovery time (`tREC0`). Value from `0` to `15`.

config_entries.label: Reset Low Time
config_entries.description: Adjust the reset low time (`tRSTL`). Value from `0` to `15`.

config_entries.label: Write 0 Low Time
config_entries.description: Adjust the write-0 low time (`tW0L`). Value from `0` to `15`.
